summary: The bad() entry point exposes the sensitive PATH environment variable value by concatenating System.getenv("PATH") directly into an output line (CWE-526). The repair still reads the environment variable and still writes an informative, non-constant status line, but reports only whether the variable is set rather than disclosing its contents, eliminating the information-exposure flow while preserving the logging feature.

edits.new:
String path = System.getenv("PATH");
            IO.writeLine("PATH environment variable is " + (path != null ? "set" : "not set"));
